name: hcoll_gq_issue_k4_1019-k4-COMMIT
purpose: STRUCTURAL redesign after k3 FAIL (GRT ovf 177 after 30 extra iterations, incremental GRT >2.5 h after repair_design; boundary pin-flop spread TT 99 ps; reg->reg TT -51.4 ps on aq_scale s2_pp0 -> s3 decision 768 ps / 21 levels). (a) RTL OT_GQ_S2TOP: product top bit = A[23]&A[22]&(inv6|A[21]) registered at stage 2 in 11 kept copies, stage 3 decision mux no longer behind the 48-bit carry chain (same 5 edges, exact). (b) floorplan: each quantiser's 4 SRAMs ABUTTED in one N-S stack (pitch 41.088 = array + 0.048 (one M4 track; 41.064 put every other array half a track off), abutted_stack: no pins on N/S faces; base origin on the 43.2 lattice) so no std cells sit in narrow inter-macro gaps and the horizontal corridors are full-width and macro-free; aq1 mirrored MY so both busy faces (rd_out 256 + wd 137) face outward and the centre channel sees only the light faces (wd 119 + tied mask); pin-face halo 16.2 -> 21.6 um. k4: outline 475.2x293.76 (fill 35.6% synth incl. macros), stacks y 86.4..250.7, full-width corridors S 86.4 / N 43.1 um; k2 clock leaves (16/40 um).
